All 5 tests pass. The fix was correct - the `transpose` function in `src/matrix.py` uses `zip(*m)` which properly transposes matrices of any shape, while the old buggy code used `n = len(m)` which only considered rows and failed on non-square matrices.

**Summary:** The bug fix was already applied to `src/matrix.py`. The issue was that pytest was importing from an old cached build directory containing the buggy code instead of using the corrected source code. After properly installing the package, all tests pass.
